messages:
Priya (PM): Quick async: quarterly milepost catch-up for Search Relevance project. Owners: Devon (backend), Maya (frontend). TL;DR: backend feature is on staging, frontend delayed by a couple CR items + infra dependency. Can owners confirm status, next steps, and any blockers?

Devon (Eng): We merged the ranking model change to staging yesterday. Throughput looks stable. One infra change required for consistent KV cache invalidation before prod — cc @Kyle.

Maya (Frontend): Raised CR comments — waiting on a11y fix + tiny design tweak. I can do the fixes today but need the new API contract from Devon (header rename).

Devon (Eng): API change is one header: X-User-Context. Contract snippet:```
GET /search?q=...&model=ranker-v2
Headers: X-User-Context: {region}
```I'll push a compatibility shim to staging now so frontend can validate.

Kyle (Infra): \:wave I can do the KV invalidation flip — need a 30-min migration window in prod. Options: Tue 10:30-11:00 UTC or Wed 02:00-02:30 UTC. Which works for the team?

Anna (Product): Tue morning is better for NA customers. If Ops can do Tue 10:30, Maya can ship after QA.

Maya (Frontend): Tue 10:30 UTC is late for my timezone but I can be on call. I'll aim to merge CRs by 09:30 UTC so QA has time.

DeployBot: deploybot: canary deploy scheduled for 2024-08-13T10:40:00Z if all prechecks pass.

Devon (Eng): Rollout plan: start canary 10:40 at 5% traffic, watch latency + error budget for 20m, then 50% at 11:10, full by 11:40. I'll drop a smoke test:```
curl -sS -H 'X-User-Context: us-west' 'https://staging.api.redwood.ai/search?q=trees&model=ranker-v2' | jq .results[0]
```

Maya (Frontend): I'll run e2e smoke on canary after the 5% bump and confirm UI rendering.

Priya (PM): Owners & next steps summary: Devon — push shim + smoke script (today). Maya — finish CRs + run e2e (by Tue 09:30 UTC). Kyle — migration window Tue 10:30 UTC. Anna — coordinate comms to beta customers. I'll update the OKR doc and mark 'backend shipped' and 'frontend in progress'. Any blockers?

Maya (Frontend): One blocker: need design sign-off on the microcopy change for search results. @Anna can you confirm?

Anna (Product): Confirmed — design signed off. See copy here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=example-copy (small change).

Priya (PM): Thanks all \:thumbsup: I'll mark the milestone as "partial shipped" and create a follow-up ticket to track post-launch metrics (CTR, latency regressions). Ping in this thread if anything slips.

Kyle (Infra): Noted. I'll add the maintenance window to calendar and create a short runbook with rollback steps.

DeployBot: deploybot: deployment window added to calendar.

Devon (Eng): ack. I'll post a quick checklist once the shim is up: 1) shim to staging, 2) smoke script run, 3) infra flag flip, 4) canary monitor.

Maya (Frontend): sgtm — I'll post a follow-up here once CRs are merged.

Priya (PM): Great, thanks everyone. Going to update the OKR sheet and tag the milestone owners. If anything changes, call it out here.

Kyle (Infra): > ack — will coordinate with SRE on alerts.

Priya (PM): End of thread summary: backend staging ok, frontend pending CR & copy, infra migration scheduled Tue 10:30 UTC, canary plan in place. Next check: Tue 09:00 UTC quick ping.
